subject.title: Feature request: Session TTL / max lifetime for automatic rotation

question: Should OpenClaw add normal-session max-age and max-turn automatic rotation, and what config shape plus memory/continuity contract should it use?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix defines new public lifecycle config and behavior for preserving state across automatic session resets.

options.title: Add opt-in lifecycle policy
options.body: Extend the session reset policy with maintainer-approved max-age and max-turn triggers plus explicit pre-rotation memory and continuity semantics.

options.title: Fold into broader session boundaries
options.body: Keep this issue open as a requirement but implement it only as part of the broader session-boundary and context-retention design.

options.title: Defer automatic rotation
options.body: Document cron, compaction, context-pruning, and manual reset mitigations while avoiding new core session lifecycle config for now.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in lifecycle policy
recommendation.body: Extend the session reset policy with maintainer-approved max-age and max-turn triggers plus explicit pre-rotation memory and continuity semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the daily reset policy and is the strongest available owner for the cross-boundary product decision.
